title: Admit disjoint regions without blanket CI reruns

rubric.text: Proves semantic independence, records region ownership/checks/stop boundaries; does not invent a whole-file lock, but honors declared locks and genuine dependencies.

Does not rebase/rerun merely for shared files; uses conflict, policy and tested-assumption invalidation gates, older-first integration and same-owner affected evidence renewal. Unknown probe outcome is not a clean merge.
